abstract: Validates precision dual-loop climate control and standard vault shelving capacity
system_message:
You are HVAC and Conservation Director (HPC). As the HVAC and Conservation Director (HPC), you validate precision dual-loop climate control and standard vault shelving capacity across candidate disaster recovery repository facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Dew point stabilization testing（HUMID）
information_points.content:
HPC-HUMID-BDB：Environmental logger telemetry indicates that Cheviot Highland Archive Bunker exhibits a relative humidity fluctuation tolerance of 5% in its manuscript storage area.
HPC-HUMID-R3B：Environmental logger telemetry for Cotswold Subterranean Vaults records a relative humidity fluctuation tolerance of 2% across a 30-day baseline in the archival chamber.
HPC-HUMID-LH2：Pennine Deep Rock Repository demonstrated a relative humidity fluctuation tolerance of 8% based on the 30-day archival chamber environmental log.

information_points.title: Validates precision dual-loop climate control and standard vault shelving capacity（ENV）
information_points.content:
HPC-ENV-0H1：For Pennine Deep Rock Repository, assessments conducted in the full production environment show that certified climate control redundancy is false, while the measured standard vault shelving capacity stands at 4,500 m3.
HPC-ENV-ZXW：For Cotswold Subterranean Vaults, records from the pre-commissioning test environment indicate that certified climate control redundancy is false, alongside a standard vault shelving capacity of 3,200 m3.
HPC-ENV-B7K：For Cotswold Subterranean Vaults, evaluations within the full production environment confirm that certified climate control redundancy is true, with an N+1 redundant climate control loop commissioned with automatic failover, while the standard vault shelving capacity provides 3,200 m3 of net usable archive shelf enclosure volume.
HPC-ENV-HR1：For Cheviot Highland Archive Bunker, mechanical audits within the full production environment establish that certified climate control redundancy is true, and the facility delivers a standard vault shelving capacity of 5,800 m3 across its heavy-duty motorized compact shelving ranges.
